the harness must *allow* the model to give up / declare a blocker, and you must instrument whether it does
features.justification_quote: "Recognizes unsolvability and stops cleanly" is a *success* outcome... the most important positive signal in the whole eval.

features.quote: If you optimize purely for reproduction rate, the cleanest way to trigger a spiral is to make tasks impossible in ways that are *also unfair or undetectable*
features.justification_quote: your eval will partly be measuring 'how good are we at building deceptive harnesses,' which drifts over time and won't tell you whether model changes helped.
